nodes.label: Gradle Build (buildPlugin / runIde)
nodes.rationale: Builders in Iran may need an HTTPS proxy in ~/.gradle/gradle.properties to reach cache-redirector.jetbrains.com / Maven Central.

nodes.label: Permission Modes (default, acceptEdits, plan, bypassPermissions)
nodes.rationale: In headless mode interactive approval is impossible, so tools needing approval are denied under default; acceptEdits is the default to allow file edits; the panel reports denied tools.

nodes.label: Claude Farsi IntelliJ Plugin
nodes.rationale: The official Claude Code plugin runs the CLI inside the IDE terminal, which renders Persian letters disconnected and reversed; this plugin runs Claude headless and renders output in a JCEF HTML panel with proper RTL/bidi support.

nodes.label: SIL Open Font License 1.1
nodes.rationale: OFL permits bundling the font with software provided the copyright notice and license accompany it; font may not be sold by itself.

nodes.label: RTL / Bidi Rendering (unicode-bidi: plaintext)
nodes.rationale: Each paragraph detects its direction from its first strong character; code and file paths always LTR, so mixed Persian/English text displays correctly.
